THE CHALLENGE

The problem behind the project.

Turning a prompt and structured slide content into a presentation requires reliable backend processing, API integration, and a deployable application.

THE APPROACH

Connecting the pieces.

Built and deployed a Django application that converts user prompts and structured slide and scene JSON into Google Slides presentations.

  • Integrated Google Slides API workflows into the backend.
  • Handled prompts and structured slide and scene JSON.
  • Managed Docker deployment and Linux hosting.
  • Configured domain routing and Cloudflare.
THE RESULT

What this project delivers.

A deployed backend application that connects presentation generation with containerized hosting and domain routing.
